name: job-hunter
description: Runs a job or contract search as a pipeline instead of a pile of tabs. Scores a posting against a declared profile and says pursue or skip with the reason, writes portfolio case studies from a codebase or live app, tailors the application to one posting, and tracks every opportunity with follow-ups that come due. Use when reviewing a job ad, gig or RFP, deciding whether to apply or bid, writing a proposal, cover letter or CV variant, or asking what needs chasing.
